title: བསྟན་འགྱུར། སྡེ་དགེ། དབུ་མ། ཁི (Derge Tengyur, vol. 111)
shelf_note: Treatise from the Madhyamaka section (vol. 111 / Khi) of the Derge Tengyur citing Mahāyāna liturgical sources and the Daśabhūmika Sūtra bodhisattva aspirations.

tr_errors_A.problem: Opening fragment 'in verse, or' omitted and replaced with ellipses
Clause specifying the duration across counted eons of buddhas appearing is omitted from the second aspiration formula

pages.prefer_reason: Translation B is fully complete and faithful to the source folio, preserving the opening clause fragment, precise technical terms, the full eon-formula in the second aspiration, and the natural folio-break continuation.

book_verdict: Clear scan of Derge Tengyur folio 319a with flawless transcription and an excellent, faithful translation in B.
